Package org.tasktide.core.model.job_env.metrics

Class MetricProfile

java.lang.Object
org.tasktide.core.model.job_env.metrics.MetricProfile
All Implemented Interfaces:
TaskTideModel<MetricProfile>
@Entity public class MetricProfile extends Object implements TaskTideModel<MetricProfile>
Holds ProfileData and computes mean across its observed MetricData datapoints as its own Entity.
